checks.name: Defaults and undo
checks.observed: Use defaults changes the draft; Undo restores the previous draft choices.

checks.name: Notification draft recovery
checks.observed: A second clean tab offered the saved browser draft and restored it.

checks.name: Notification concurrent saves
checks.observed: Two tabs produced a 409 conflict; Keep edited channels preserved the edited maintenance channel and adopted the other tab's untouched import choice.

checks.name: Search, scope and filters
checks.observed: Handover search, inherited-event filtering, read-only role defaults, clear filters and header Find view navigation operated correctly.

checks.name: Shared row actions
checks.observed: Kebab and right-click menus exposed the same preview, default and source actions.

checks.name: Notification preview

checks.name: Preview keyboard focus
checks.observed: Escape closed the preview and returned focus to the invoking row action after the final focus repair.

checks.name: Saved-choice dry run
checks.observed: Check captured the saved revision and channel choices, explicitly sent no messages, and appeared in the actor's last-five history; array mailer was not presented as external delivery.

checks.name: Required-response boundary
checks.observed: Optional preference controls retain the separate Control Room response obligation and do not grant personal-location access.

checks.name: Map draft recovery
checks.observed: Second clean tab restored the entered project text from the pending map configuration draft.

checks.name: Map concurrent saves
checks.observed: Two-tab version conflict displayed the comparison; Keep my changes merged the edited fields and saved.

checks.name: Map activation validation
checks.observed: Attempt without credentials/review returned a useful 422 validation response. Google remained off; cancellation/discard worked.

checks.name: Nested discard guard
checks.observed: Escape from the discard guard returned focus to Cancel in the underlying configuration wizard.

checks.name: Tracking policy details
checks.observed: Current source-owned policy values and the 480px read-only detail dialog were usable.

checks.name: Permitted tracker metadata
checks.observed: Directory progressed from empty state to the permitted synthetic tracker, showing model/firmware/contact metadata. Separate device-scope-check.json confirms foreign-Site exclusion and absence of position/assignment fields.

checks.name: Canonical tracker handoff
checks.observed: Existing device page opened and correctly withheld telemetry from the fixture actor. No device command was executed.

checks.name: Canonical import handoff
checks.observed: Existing importer opened with mapping, validation and correction workflow; no file was uploaded or import executed.

checks.name: Canonical boundary handoff
checks.observed: Existing Maps & boundaries workspace opened with OSM attribution; no boundary was changed.

checks.name: Change history
checks.observed: Own preference saves and permitted shared map saves appeared in history.

checks.name: Header focus and clipping
checks.observed: Shared overflow-clip treatment prevented rail focus from scrolling the page title away.

checks.name: Light and dark layouts
checks.observed: Checked actual 1440x1000, 1366x768 and 1280x800 viewports in both themes. No horizontal overflow in measured short desktop layouts.

limitations: Manual owner observations are not fresh Main execution and are separate from the frozen v6 mockup's 54 journeys.
Expected 409 and 422 responses occurred during conflict and validation checks; no claim of zero errors across all journeys is made.
The existing unrelated user-menu Settings link uses /profile and returned 404; canonical settings uses /settings/profile. This baseline menu defect was not changed.
Reload of a dirty form was prevented or dismissed by the browser; persistence evidence uses a clean reload and draft recovery uses another clean tab.
Google SDK/API lifecycle uses synthetic automated tests. Live credentials, CSP/provider compatibility, quotas and billing remain an authorised deployment check.
People Locations genuine 125 percent browser-zoom verification remains with its owner; this packet does not claim it.
MAIN-TELEM-01 and historical accuracy/address provenance repairs remain outside this candidate.
